content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MHI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MHI Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Consultant positions in the Ministry of Heavy Industries.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Young Professional) post?
faq.answer: The Consultant (Young Professional) will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 70,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Consultant (Young Professional) role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be CA/ICWA/MBA Finance/Post Graduate in Commerce with 1 year of post-qualification experience in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible for the Consultant (Retired Central Government Officer) position?
faq.answer: This position is for officers retired as Senior Accounts Officer or above from any organised Accounts Department of the Central Government with experience in Accounts and Audit work.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the MHI Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply by sending their applications via email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these consultant roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening process followed by a personal interview, which may be conducted in a hybrid or in-person mode.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for MHI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the Ministry of Heavy Industries?
faq.answer: The official website of the Ministry of Heavy Industries is www.heavyindustries.gov.in.
